Succ-Flux

这是我的 Succ-Flux 工作流程的第一次迭代。配色方案基于 Catppuccin。布局基于红粉色复古的清洁 wifi 节点技术。我计划继续开发这个工作流程。请务必在下面留下反馈，我想看看你能用它做什么。

Just found a potential issue (possibly only affecting Linux users).如果您遇到 Vextra-Nodes 问题，请导航至 custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Vextra-Nodes/nodes 并删除 DT_Play_Sound_At_执行.py

更新将撤消此更改，但您可以删除 custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Vextra-Nodes/ 中的 .git 文件夹，以便 comfy 不会自动拉取更新。

我将在下一个版本中删除 Vextra-Nodes。

o.en:
Succ-Flux

This is the first iteration of my Succ-Flux workflow. The color scheme is based on Catppuccin. The layout is based onredpinkretro'sclean wifi node techniques. I plan to continue developing this workflow. Make sure to leave feedback below, I'd like to see what you can make with it.

Just found a potential issue (possibly only affecting Linux users). If you're having an issue with Vextra-Nodes, navigate to custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Vextra-Nodes/nodes and remove DT_Play_Sound_At_Execution.py

Updating will undo this change, but you can delete the .git folder in custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Vextra-Nodes/ so that comfy doesn't automatically pull updates.

I'll be removing Vextra-Nodes in the next release.
